title: Iteration 2 of the cozy 3D Pixel Art game built with Opus 5.5
author: BroEvenIDK
selftext:
So a while back i posted about Willowmere- the 3D pixel art cozy game i built

I got lots of positive feedback (and some negative) and so i was motivated to keep iterating on it with Claude code.

today i want to share a newer version of willowmere with you all.

here's what this new version offers:

* **Story:** a night-ferry cold open, Lantern Night closing Act I, the hydrophone and Old Hum in Act II, the Homecoming through the Teeth in Act III, credits, and a true ending.
* **New things to do:** Low Tide (tides, rock pools, Great Shell collections), lantern-making, moonlight fishing, and Keep Watch, where you guide ships with the beam.
* **World and art:** a whale-bone cove and pier, a full art and animation pass, and 3D-rendered portraits with expressions.
* **Fixes:** the fixes from previous posts that users reported

I hope you all will enjoy this!

in this iteration, mostly medium effort was used with opus 5.5

since a lot of people asked about this before on how the graphics are made:  
**everything you see is made in code by claude. no asset files are used. everything you see is in vanilla HTML and JS. no game engines were used.**

if you had a bad experience with it before, please try it again, hopefully this time it should be a lot better and feel less like a ripoff of stardew valley.

its free to try and runs in your browser, try it [here](http://willowmere-nu.vercel.app/), thank you!
